title: Solving the pre-image problem in kernel PCA: The reproducing property is all you need
abstract: arXiv:2611.27718v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Kernel PCA extends PCA to nonlinear dimensionality reduction by implicitly mapping data into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) via the kernel trick, with applications ranging from image denoising to out-of-distribution detection. While its projection map is well understood, appropriately defining the associated reconstruction map is a longstanding challenge since projecting back from the RKHS to the input space is non-trivial. This is known as the pre-image problem. Existing approaches have tackled this problem by either relying on nonlinear optimization, which is prone to numerical instabilities and sensitive to initialization, or by solving a separate supervised learning problem, incurring additional computational overhead. translated_title: 解决核PCA中的预像问题：再生性质就足够了
translated_abstract: 核PCA通过核技巧将数据隐式映射到再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS），从而将PCA扩展到非线性降维，其应用范围涵盖图像去噪到分布外检测。虽然其投影映射已被充分理解，但如何恰当地定义相应的重构映射却是一个长期存在的挑战，因为从RKHS投影回输入空间并非易事。这就是所谓的预像问题。现有方法解决该问题的途径要么依赖非线性优化，这容易产生数值不稳定性且对初始化敏感；要么通过求解一个额外的监督学习问题，带来额外的计算开销。此外，尽管当使用线性核时核PCA的投影映射会退化为标准PCA的投影映射，但大多数现有方法并不能保证在这种情况下恢复PCA的重构映射。
tldr: 本文提出仅利用再生性质即可直接求解核PCA的预像问题，无需非线性优化或额外的监督学习，同时在线性核情形下能自然退化为标准PCA的重构映射。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the reproducing property alone is sufficient to solve the pre-image problem in kernel PCA, avoiding nonlinear optimization and extra supervised learning while naturally recovering PCA's reconstruction map under a linear kernel.
